description: Verbatim capture of four real Round-B `merge.landed` product event lines emitted by the PARK-first managed landing (src/installer/merge-branch.ts, serialized by src/installer/events.ts). Each line is a non-noop landing into a dirty checked-out target: noop:false, checkoutRefresh `parked:<backup>`, parkedBranch, parkedReason `local-changes`. These lines pin the product contract the engine's own state shape does NOT reproduce: the product writes a BARE-uuid `runId` into `<bare>.jsonl` + all.jsonl while the engine/state/report renders the same run as `run-<uuid>`.

provenance.capture_command: bin/tamandua merge-branch --origin <fresh hermetic non-bare origin with main checked out and dirtied> --branch <run-scoped branch one commit ahead> --into main --expect-tip <main tip> --run-id <bare> --message <product merge message>
provenance.note: The four fixture lines are the exact JSON lines the real product appended (verbatim, no rewrite) to <stateRoot>/events/<bare>.jsonl and <stateRoot>/events/all.jsonl. Four independent dirty-checkout fixtures were used because the product parks only the first landing on a given checked-out target (later landings find no attached owner). Retained attempt-8/9 noop/already-coherent lines live in the negative fixture directory torture-test/fixtures/storm-product-events-negative/.
